titulo_it: Mi ha detto che era stanco
titulo_es: The Indirect Speech: Tell What Someone Said

raccontare.consejo: Regular verb of the first conjugation.

spiegare.consejo: Regular verb of the first conjugation.

texto: If someone says «sono stanco» (present), when you tell it in the past you say: **Ha detto che era stanco** (said he was tired).
The present of the direct quote becomes imperfect in the reference story.
The pronouns and verbal people are adapted: «io» passes to «lui» or «lei». **Mi ha detto che non voleva venire** (he told me he didn't want to come).

filas: Ha detto che andava a casa.
He said he was going home.

bloques.titulo: My ha detto che was stanco

frases.it: Sì, ci siamo visti al bar. Mi ha detto che era stanco.
frases.es: Sí, nos vimos en el bar. Me dijo que estaba cansado.
frases.en: Yeah, I met you at the bar. He told me he was tired.

frases.it: Ha detto che aveva lavorato tutto il giorno e che andava a casa a riposare.
frases.es: Dijo que había trabajado todo el día y que iba a casa a descansar.
frases.en: He said he had worked all day and went home to rest.
analisis: and that I was going home

bloques.pregunta: How do you change the «sono stanco» present by moving it to indirect style after «ha detto che»?

opciones.texto: Pasa a imperfecto: «ha detto che era stanco».
opciones.explicacion: Temporary consistency: the direct present becomes imperfect in the past story.

opciones.texto: Se mantiene en presente: «ha detto che sono stanco».
opciones.explicacion: Maintaining «sono» deflects the temporal perspective and the subject of the story.

opciones.texto: It must go into a simple future.
opciones.explicacion: The future does not express simularity in the past.

bloques.pregunta: What does «ha detto che aveva fame» mean?

opciones.texto: He said he was hungry.
opciones.explicacion: Indirect style with «avere» imperfect.

opciones.texto: He said he'll be hungry later.
opciones.explicacion: That would be a projection of the future.

opciones.texto: He says he's hungry right now.
opciones.explicacion: The introductory verb is in the past («ha detto»).

bloques.frase: Marco mi ___ che non poteva venire alla cena di stasera.

opciones.texto: ha detto
opciones.explicacion: Passato prossimo del verbo «dire» as an introductory to the speech referred to.

opciones.texto: dice
opciones.explicacion: It is present as an indication: «dice».

opciones.texto: dirà
opciones.explicacion: It's a simple future: «will say».

bloques.frase: Ha detto che non voleva venire alla festa.

opciones.texto: That at the time of speaking the person had no intention of going to the party.
opciones.explicacion: It expresses the negative in the past by means of subordinate imperfect («voleva»).

opciones.texto: That the person will attend the party with great enthusiasm.
opciones.explicacion: It affirms the opposite will not to go.

opciones.texto: Que el evento ya concluyó con una asistencia masiva.
opciones.explicacion: It is about the position expressed by the guest.

bloques.pregunta: What verbal form is «andava» in this context?
bloques.frase: Mi ha detto che andava a casa a riposare.

opciones.texto: Imperfetto de indicativo del verbo «andare» que sustituye al presente «vado».
opciones.explicacion: Temporary correlation rule in indirect discourse.

opciones.texto: Simple future with firm promise value.
opciones.explicacion: The future of andare would be «andrà».

opciones.texto: Congiuntivo presente de opinión.
opciones.explicacion: «Andava» belongs to the indicative mode.

bloques.frase: Ha detto che andava subito a casa a riposare
bloques.traduccion: He said he was going home to rest.
bloques.explicacion: Indirect speech with introductory verb in past and subordinate in imperfect.

bloques.pregunta: How do you say «He told me he was tired.» (a man)?

opciones.texto: Mi ha detto che era stanco.
opciones.explicacion: «Mi ha detto» + che + imperfect essere with masculine adjective.

opciones.texto: Mi ha detto che ero stanco.
opciones.explicacion: «Ero» would change the subject to «I».

opciones.texto: Mi ha detto che è stanco.
opciones.explicacion: In the traditional indirect style in the past, the imperfect «era» is preferred.

bloques.frase: Luca ha spiegato che non ___ venire per il traffico.

opciones.texto: poteva
opciones.explicacion: Incentive imperfect of the modal verb «potere».

opciones.texto: può
opciones.explicacion: It is present as an indication: «may».

opciones.texto: potrò
opciones.explicacion: It's a first-person future, singular.

intro: To tell what another person said, the indirect style («discorso indiretto») is used. In Italian it is introduced with «dire che», and when the main verb is in the past, the times of the phrase change as in Spanish.
